responseMessageContents.text:
You are on the **Copilot pricing page**. Please do **not** buy Copilot for this issue—it will not restart IVX’s GitHub Actions runners.

Use this exact link instead:

**https://github.com/settings/billing**

Then:

1. Look for **Billing & licensing** or **Plans and usage**  
2. Select **Actions** — not Copilot  
3. Check for a payment warning or an Actions spending limit of **$0**  
4. If shown, pay/clear the warning and set a small Actions limit (for example **$5–$10**)  
5. Save

Your Enterprise trial can remain active, but the IVX repository is under your personal `ibb142` account, so its **Actions billing** needs to be active separately. Send a screenshot of the **Actions billing/spending** page—not Copilot—and I’ll tell you exactly what to press next.
